add_zone.title: Add a Heating Zone
add_zone.description: A zone is an area controlled by a single thermostat (e.g., Ground Floor, First Floor). You'll add rooms to this zone in the next step.

data_description.name: Name for this zone (e.g., 'Ground Floor', 'Upstairs')
data_description.zone_thermostat: The main thermostat that controls heating for this zone

add_room.title: Add Room to {zone_name}
add_room.description: Add a room with its TRV and optional window sensors. You have added {room_count} room(s) so far.

data_description.name: Name for this room (e.g., 'Living Room', 'Bedroom')
data_description.trv_entity: The climate entity for this room's radiator valve
data_description.window_sensors: Window/door sensors - heating pauses when open
data_description.priority: Priority for this room (1-10, where 10 is highest priority)

zone_complete.title: Zone {zone_name} complete
zone_complete.description: You have added {room_count} room(s) to this zone. Would you like to add another room?

data.add_another_room: Add another room to this zone

zones_complete.title: Zones Configuration Complete
zones_complete.description: You have configured {zone_count} zone(s). Would you like to add another zone or continue to global settings?

settings.title: Global Heating Settings
settings.description: Configure global settings that apply to all zones and rooms.

data_description.temp_differential: How far below target temperature before requesting heat (e.g., 0.5°C means heat when 0.5° below target)
data_description.min_cycle_time: Minimum time between zone thermostat on/off changes to prevent rapid cycling
data_description.window_delay: Wait time after window opens before pausing heating (prevents false triggers)

reconfigure.title: Edit Zone Configuration
reconfigure.description: You have {zone_count} configured zone(s). Select which zone to edit.

reconfigure_zone.title: Edit Zone Details
reconfigure_zone.description: Update the zone name or thermostat.

reconfigure_zone_menu.title: Manage {zone_name} rooms
reconfigure_zone_menu.description: This zone has {room_count} room(s). Choose an action.

select_room_to_edit.title: Select Room to Edit
select_room_to_edit.description: Choose which room you want to edit.

select_room_to_delete.title: Select Room to Delete
select_room_to_delete.description: Choose which room you want to delete.

error.invalid_thermostat: Selected zone thermostat does not exist or is not a climate entity
error.duplicate_zone_thermostat: This thermostat is already used in another zone
error.invalid_trv: Selected TRV entity does not exist or is not a climate entity
error.duplicate_trv: This TRV is already used in another room in this zone

init.title: Global Heating Settings
init.description: Update global settings that apply to all zones and rooms. The integration will reload to apply changes.
